__comment__: This file was automatically created by mcresources
name: Wild Animals

pages.text: O mundo do TFC está cheio de vida animal. Alguns animais estão aqui para ajudar, e outros são incrivelmente perigosos. Esta seção é sobre animais selvagens. Para obter informações sobre gado, animais que podem fornecer itens que você precisa, consulte o $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry)Criação animal$() página.

Os animais podem ser agrupados em algumas categorias diferentes: $(l:the_world/wild_animals#predators)Predadores$(), $(l:the_world/wild_animals#prey)Prey$(), e $(l:the_world/wild_animals#aquatic)Aquatic$() animais.$(br2)As próximas páginas detalharão cada uma dessas categorias de animais.

$(thing)Predadores$() são animais que podem atacar o jogador. Eles são $(thing)Nocturnal$(), apenas caça à noite, ou $(thing)Diurnal$(), Apenas caçando durante o dia. Os predadores podem ser neutros ou hostis, dependendo se eles mataram um alvo recentemente. Os predadores têm um território doméstico que eles defenderão - se você correr longe o suficiente, o predador vai parar de perseguir e voltar para casa.
pages.title: Predadores

pages.name: Urso polar
pages.text: The polar bear spawns in only the coldest regions, $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() at most 10°C, with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 100mm.

pages.name: Urso pardo
pages.text: The grizzly bear spawns in forests of moderate climates, with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() range of -15 to 15°C and at least 200mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$().

pages.name: Urso preto
pages.text: The black bear spawns in forests of warmer, wetter climates, of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() 5 to 20°C and at least 250mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$().

pages.name: Puma
pages.text: The cougar prefers most moderate climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() from -10 to 21°C and at least 150mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$().

pages.name: Pantera
pages.text: The panther prefers most moderate climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() from -10 to 21°C and at least 150mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$().

pages.name: Leoa
pages.text: The lion spawns in plains with an average $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 16°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 50 and 300mm.

pages.name: Tiger
pages.text: The tiger spawns in forests with an average $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 13°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() above 100mm.

pages.name: Sabertooth
pages.text: The sabertooth spawns at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() above 0°C, and any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() above 250mm.

The wolf spawns at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below 22°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 150 and 420mm. They hunt in packs. Feeding a wolf enough times will tame it into a $(l:food/pets)Dog$().

The direwolf spawns at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below freezing, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 150 and 420mm. They hunt in packs. They are larger than regular wolves, and are not tamable.

The hyena spawns at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() warmer than 15°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 80 and 380mm. They hunt in packs. They are not tamable.

pages.name: Crocodile
pages.text: The crocodile spawns near rivers, lakes, and marshes at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() warmer than 15°C, and at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are nocturnal, and most dangerous in the water.

The ocelot attacks small animals. It spawns at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() from 15 to 30°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 300 and 500mm, in forests. Feeding an ocelot enough times will tame it into a $(l:food/pets)Cat$(). Ocelots can eat raw fish
$(thing)Ramming$() animals occasionally attempt to charge nearby creatures, including the player. Their attacks are powerful, but can be dodged. They will ram more frequently if attacked.
pages.title: Ramming

pages.name: Javali
pages.text: The boar spawns at $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below 25°C and above -5°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 130 and 400mm.
The moose spawns in forests at $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below 10°C and above -15°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 150 and 300mm.
The wildebeest spawns in open plains at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() above 13°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 90 and 380mm.

pages.name: Bison
pages.text: The bison spawns in open plains at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() above -10°C and below 15°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 160 and 420mm.
$(thing)Presa$() Os animais temem jogadores e predadores. Eles são hábeis em fugir do perigo, mas geralmente não podem revidar. Alguns animais de presa gostam de lanches nas colheitas.
pages.title: Presa

pages.name: Raposa
pages.text: The fox likes to eat the berries off of bushes. It can be found in forests with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below 25°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 130 and 400mm.
The deer spawns in forests at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below 25°C and above -15°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 130 and 400mm.

pages.name: Caribou
pages.text: The caribou spawns at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below -9°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 110 and 500mm.
The gazelle spawns in open plains at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() above 12°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 90 and 380mm.

pages.name: Bongo
pages.text: The bongo spawns in forests at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() above 15°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 230 and 500mm.
The grouse spawns at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below 13°C and above -12°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 150 and 400mm.
The pheasant spawns in forests at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below 17°C and above -5°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 100 and 300mm.
The turkey spawns in forests at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() below 17°C and above 0°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 250 and 450mm.

pages.name: Peafowl
pages.text: The peafowl spawns in forests at any $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() above 14°C, and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() between 190 and 500mm.

$(thing)Animais aquaticos$() são uma categoria ampla que abrange vários comportamentos diferentes. Eles podem ser $(thing)Moradores da costa$(), $(thing)Peixe$(), $(thing)Marisco$(), ou $(thing)Grandes criaturas aquáticas$()
pages.title: Animais aquaticos

pages.text: $(thing)Animais em terra$() Apenas aparece nas margens do mar e passa um pouco do dia nadando e alguns andando na praia. São criaturas curiosas e seguirão o jogador, mas não podem ser domadas.

pages.name: Pinguim
pages.text: The penguin spawns on only the coldest beaches, ice sheet edges, and sea ice with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at most -14°C and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 75mm.

pages.name: Leopard Seal
pages.text: The Leopard Seal spawns on cold beaches, ice sheet edges, and sea ice with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperatures$() of at most -9°C and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 105mm.

pages.name: Tartaruga marinha
pages.text: The sea turtle likes warm water. It spawns in $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 21°C and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 250mm.
$(thing)Peixe$() são pequenas criaturas que nadam na água. A maioria deles pode ser $(l:mechanics/fishing)pesco$(). Alguns preferem oceanos, rios ou lagos.
pages.title: Peixe

pages.name: Bacalhau
pages.text: Cod prefer colder oceans, $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() at most 18°C. They can be fished.

pages.name: Baiacu
pages.text: Pufferfish live in any ocean with at least a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of 10°C.

pages.name: Água-viva
pages.text: Jellyfish live in warmer oceans, with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 18°C.

pages.name: Peixe tropical
pages.text: Tropical fish prefer warmer oceans, with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 18°C.

pages.name: Salmão
pages.text: Salmon spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -8°C and at most 12°C and with rainfall of at least 250 mm.

pages.name: Rainbow Trout
pages.text: Rainbow Trout spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -12°C and at most 10°C and with rainfall of at least 150 mm.

pages.name: Lake Trout
pages.text: Lake Trout spawn in any lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -5°C and at most 15°C and with rainfall of at least 250 mm.

pages.name: Largemouth Bass
pages.text: Largemouth Bass spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -14°C and at most 16°C and with rainfall of at least 200 mm.

pages.name: Smallmouth Bass
pages.text: Smallmouth Bass spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -14°C and at most 16°C and with rainfall of less than 300 mm.

pages.name: Crappie
pages.text: Bluegill nasce em qualquer rio ou lago com nasce$() de pelo menos -10°C e no máximo 26°C.

pages.name: Bluegill
pages.text: Bluegill nasce em qualquer rio ou lago com nasce$() de pelo menos -10°C e no máximo 26°C.

pages.name: Northern Pike
pages.text: Northern Pike spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -10°C and at most 26°C with rainfall between 150 mm and 400 mm.

pages.name: Peacock Bass
pages.text: Peacock Bass spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 12°C and at most 25°C with rainfall between 200 mm and 400 mm.

pages.name: Arctic Char
pages.text: Arctic Char spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -20°C and at most -8°C with rainfall between 150mm and 400 mm.

pages.name: Muksun
pages.text: Muksun spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -20°C and at most -10°C with rainfall of at least 250 mm.

pages.name: Burbot
pages.text: Burbot spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -16°C and at most -9°C with rainfall less than 350 mm.

pages.name: Tilapia
pages.text: Tilapia spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 10°C and at most 32°C with rainfall less than 300 mm.

pages.name: Spotted Gudgeon
pages.text: Spotted Gudgeon spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 6°C and at most 24°C with rainfall less than 250 mm.

pages.name: Pacu
pages.text: Pacu spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 20°C and at most 35°C with rainfall above 200 mm.

pages.name: Red Piranha
pages.text: Red Piranha spawn in any river or lake with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 22°C and at most 35°C with rainfall above 300 mm.

$(thing)Marisco$() são pequenos animais que vivem no chão de corpos de água. Eles não podem ser pescados, mas soltar conchas que podem ser comidas ou transformadas em $(l:mechanics/flux)fluxo$(). Mariscos pode ser $(l:mechanics/fishing)isca$() para peixe.
pages.title: Marisco

pages.name: Isópode
pages.text: Isopods spawn in deeper sections of oceans of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() at most 14°C.

pages.name: Lagosta
pages.text: Lobster spawn in any ocean that is at most of a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of 21°C.

pages.name: Lagostim
pages.text: Crayfish are like lobster, but spawn in rivers and lakes. They need a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 5°C and a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 125mm.

pages.name: Caranguejo-ferradura
pages.text: Horseshoe crabs spawn in oceans of moderate climate, $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between 10 and 21°C and with a $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at most 400mm.

$(thing)Grandes criaturas de água$() são animais maiores que vivem nos corpos maiores de água. Alguns deles caçam peixes. Eles caem $(l:mechanics/lamps#tallow)gordura$(), que pode ser transformado em combustível de lâmpada.
pages.title: Grandes criaturas de água

pages.name: Orca
pages.text: Orca whales live in deep oceans with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at most 19°C and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 100mm.

pages.name: Golfinho
pages.text: Dolphins live in deep oceans with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 10°C and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 200mm.

pages.name: Peixe-boi
pages.text: Manatees live in any warm lake, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 20°C and $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at most 300mm.

Lula pode gerar em qualquer oceano profundo. Eles caem $(thing)Sacos de tinta$(), e tinta qualquer jogador que chegue muito perto. Alguns dizem que as lulas em cavernas profundas e inexploradas têm propriedades estranhas.
pages.title: Lula
